guards.canonical_label: No teleological natural selection
guards.canonical_statement: Do not describe natural selection as knowing what organisms need, trying to improve species, or producing traits for a future purpose.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: No strongest-equals-fittest shortcut
guards.canonical_statement: Do not define evolutionary fitness as strength, health, speed, or survival alone; fitness is reproductive success in a particular environment.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: No individual-evolution claim
guards.canonical_statement: Do not say that an individual organism evolves genetically during its lifetime; evolutionary genetic change is tracked across generations in populations.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Natural selection is not a random mechanism
guards.canonical_statement: Do not group natural selection itself with random evolutionary change. Selection is systematic differential reproductive success acting on heritable variation.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Generation time is not mutation probability
guards.canonical_statement: Do not infer that prokaryotes have universally higher per-replication mutation rates merely because their generation times are short.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Mutation effects are context dependent
guards.canonical_statement: Do not memorize a fixed universal percentage of mutations as beneficial, neutral, or harmful; effects vary with genomic and environmental context.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Nonrandom mating does not automatically change allele frequencies
guards.canonical_statement: Nonrandom mating can alter genotype frequencies without changing allele frequencies when mating differences are not tied to differential reproductive success.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: p and q do not encode dominance
guards.canonical_statement: Never define p as dominant and q as recessive as a general rule; the symbols simply label allele frequencies.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: No square-root shortcut from arbitrary observed genotypes
guards.canonical_statement: Do not obtain allele frequencies by square-rooting observed homozygote frequencies unless Hardy-Weinberg genotype proportions are warranted.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Carbon-14 is not for all fossils
guards.canonical_statement: Do not use carbon-14 as a universal fossil-dating method; isotope choice depends on timescale and geologic context.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Vestigial does not mean functionless
guards.canonical_statement: Do not define vestigial structures as necessarily useless. They are remnants of ancestral structures and may retain reduced or modified functions.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Human appendix and coccyx are not functionless examples
guards.canonical_statement: Do not teach the human appendix or coccyx as having no function; both retain biological roles despite being evolutionary remnants of structures with different ancestral functions.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Bird and bat forelimbs remain homologous
guards.canonical_statement: Do not use wing analogy to erase homologous tetrapod forelimb ancestry; flight evolved independently while forelimb skeletal elements share common ancestry.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Early-branching does not mean primitive
guards.canonical_statement: Do not label an extant early-branching lineage as primitive, less evolved, or the direct ancestor of other living taxa.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Paraphyletic and polyphyletic labels are enrichment
guards.canonical_statement: Exact recall of paraphyletic and polyphyletic group terminology is teacher enrichment, not explicit current Unit 7 CED required content.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Parsimony is not the only phylogenetic method
guards.canonical_statement: Do not imply the tree with the fewest changes is always correct; parsimony is one inference approach and phylogenies remain hypotheses subject to new evidence.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Biological species concept has limits
guards.canonical_statement: Do not apply the interbreeding definition uncritically to asexual organisms, fossils, or geographically isolated populations for which reproductive compatibility cannot be directly tested.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Sympatric speciation is not only niche exploitation
guards.canonical_statement: Do not reduce sympatric speciation to exploitation of a new niche; several mechanisms can reduce gene flow without geographic isolation.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Hybrid sterility is not only chromosome-number mismatch
guards.canonical_statement: Do not explain all reduced hybrid fertility solely by different parental chromosome counts; other chromosomal and genic incompatibilities can disrupt fertility.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Divergence does not guarantee speciation
guards.canonical_statement: Do not state that divergent evolution automatically produces a new species; speciation additionally requires reproductive isolation.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Five mass extinctions is not a Unit 7 memorization target
guards.canonical_statement: The classroom reference to five mass extinctions is useful context, but exact memorization of that count is not a current Unit 7 CED requirement.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Do not identify all earliest fossil evidence as cyanobacteria
guards.canonical_statement: Use the CED date range for earliest life evidence without requiring the claim that the oldest evidence is definitively cyanobacterial.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Early Earth did not have abundant free oxygen
guards.canonical_statement: Do not teach abundant oxygen as a driver of prebiotic organic synthesis; free oxygen was scarce on early Earth.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Miller-Urey did not create life or macromolecules
guards.canonical_statement: Do not claim the Miller-Urey experiment produced life, cells, proteins, or nucleic acids; it demonstrated abiotic formation of small organic molecules under simulated conditions.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.

guards.canonical_label: Endosymbiosis is not the origin of first life
guards.canonical_statement: Do not use endosymbiotic theory as a model for the initial origin of life; it explains later origins of mitochondria and chloroplasts in eukaryotic evolution.
guards.enforcement: May support teacher explanation, prevent misconceptions or over-teaching, and constrain student-facing wording, but must not become a required student memorization target, exact-name Review target, or Challenge Lab requirement.
